First croissant I’ve tried in Paris and it already set the standard. It was perfectly baked with a flaky exterior and a light, buttery interior. I enjoyed it a lot!!! Not overly greasy, absolutely delicious and it’s instantly one of the best pastries I’ve had during my stay.

Their pain au chocolat was 💯💯💯💯 as a chocolate lover, I immediately fell in love with it. Crisp exterior, soft and airy interior, matched with rich and indulgent chocolate 🤤🤤🤤 definitely coming back!!

The place is simple yet really pretty and the staff welcomed me and they’re nice people 💖

À chaque passage à Paris, c’est devenu un rituel : un arrêt obligatoire chez Jolie Miche.

Leurs pains sont tout simplement incroyables, les viennoiseries à tomber, et que dire de leur Paris-Brest… un vrai chef-d’œuvre ! Même lorsque nous ne pouvons pas passer sur place, ils trouvent le moyen de nous en envoyer, pour notre plus grand bonheur.

Au-delà de la qualité exceptionnelle des produits, ce qui fait la différence, c’est l’âme de cette maison familiale. On sent immédiatement que l’établissement est tenu par des personnes passionnées, sincères et profondément attachées au travail bien fait. Cette générosité et cette exigence se retrouvent dans chaque pain, chaque pâtisserie et chaque accueil

Praticamente ci abbiamo fatto colazione (e non solo) dal 31 dicembre che siamo arrivati a Parigi, al 4 gennaio che siamo andati via. L'ho trovata per caso perché dietro il nostro hotel, e non avendo colazione in albergo cercavamo un posto nelle vicinanze. Ci è piaciuta talmente tanto che poi ogni mattina il mio compagno scendeva e mi portava in camera croissant e pain au chocolate. Deliziosi. Il croissant appena l'ho morso la prima volta mi stava scendendo la lacrimuccia. Quel burro che ti appaga e non ti stucca... eccellente. Anche gli altri dolci sono buoni, e pure le quiche salate e le baguette. Davvero un posticino top, frequentato quasi esclusivamente da local.
Excellente boulangerie. Bien meilleure que celle d'avant. Staff sympathique. Produits frais et savoureux. Viennoiseries et pains délicieux! J'y vais très fréquemment.

Excellentes viennoiseries. Excellentes miches . La jeune femme brune du matin est ultra gentille et souriante . Peut elle former ses collègues ????   Car cela est juste agréable d être accueilli avec un bonjour et un sourire ….

I visited twice, and both times the quality was excellent. The pain au chocolat, baguette, and millefeuille were all exceptionally fresh. Everything is full of flavour and crafted with care — highly recommended.

PAris July 19-24.. Frequented several times !, Couldn’t stop 🛑 craving …even 1/2 baguette at times..  What a bakery! FULL STOP. We discovered ( my 23 yo daughter and 18 yo son)this place which was down the block from where we were staying … it was our go to breakfast place.  We can still recall the salmon roll sandwich, pastrami and pain au chocolat among other items .. my favorite since I was 7 yrs has always been Kouign Amman … which not many places offer , but here it was amazing.
On our last day in Paris we decided to get 3 salmon rolls , the Kouihgn ammans and some other goodies.  We left for Orly early in the morning , once past security etc , we decided to have a “ Jolie Miche “ picnic on the Orly waiting room cafeteria !! NEeedless to say we were the envy of the restaurant as others sat there and watched us have these delicious sandwiches , while they had airport wrapped sandwiches.. Someone looked at me and laughed as he pointed to his “airport sandwich”.
Une superbe adresse, tout y est délicieux, le pain, les viennoiserie et la pâtisserie ! Et l'équipe est au top
Bestes Pain au chocolat während unserem Paris-Aufenthalt!
Excellente boulangerie ! Pain, viennoiseries et patisseries de grande qualité, accueil chaleureux. Une adresse incontournable

Tout est délicieux, autant les viennoiseries que les pâtisseries!
Foncez-y les yeux fermés, le rapport qualité prix en vaut aussi le détour...
Tout le personnel est accueillant et sympathique.
Jamais déçue depuis son ouverture!

Exactly the kind of Paris bakery you dream about

This ended up being one of our favourite breakfast stops in Paris, and honestly, it's places like this that remind you why you come here in the first place.

We'd already tried some of the famous names around the city, but Jolie Michelle absolutely nailed it. No hype, no massive queues of tourists taking photos of pastries, just seriously good baking done exceptionally well.

The first thing you notice is the constant stream of people coming and going. Then you see staff and delivery bikes loading tray after tray of fresh pastries, and it clicks – this isn't a place making a few croissants for tourists. This is what they do, and they've obviously perfected it.

The butter croissant was, without exaggerating, 10 out of 10. Beautifully flaky on the outside, incredibly light inside and packed with that rich, buttery flavour that somehow isn't heavy. Every bite shattered into those delicate layers that end up all over your clothes, and you couldn't care less because it's that good.

The pain au chocolat was every bit as impressive. Crisp pastry wrapped around proper chocolate that melted perfectly. It wasn't overly sweet, just balanced exactly the way you'd hope.

The almond croissant... wow. Easily one of the best I've ever had. Rich almond filling without being sickly, toasted almonds on top and a pastry that somehow stayed crisp despite the filling. If you're only buying one thing, make it the almond croissant.

What really made the experience though was the staff. The lady who helped us was incredibly friendly and patient, even with our very limited French. She made us feel genuinely welcome rather than like another tourist passing through, and that always makes a difference.

We paired everything with an American coffee and honestly couldn't have asked for a better breakfast. Sitting there watching locals pop in, cyclists collecting trays of pastries and the bakery humming away in the background felt like a genuine slice of Parisian life.

Sometimes the best travel memories aren't the famous monuments or the expensive restaurants. They're standing in a neighbourhood bakery with buttery crumbs everywhere, great coffee in hand and wondering how something as simple as a croissant can taste so unbelievably good.

If you're chasing the best croissants in Paris, put Jolie Michelle on your list. Skip the overpriced tourist traps and come here instead. It delivers exactly what you hope a Paris bakery will deliver – incredible pastries, friendly service and an experience that feels authentic from the moment you walk through the door.

For us, this wasn't just breakfast. It was one of those simple travel moments we'll probably remember long after we've forgotten what we spent on museum tickets. We'd happily come back tomorrow.

Checked the reviews and went there. The pastry (croissant et pain au chocolat) was amazing, as well as their desserts (I tried Danish and a small chocolate cream cake, forgot its' name), and quiche! I tried the one with salmon and quiche Lorraine.
The only minus, no sitting spots inside, but it's rather insignificant, when the food is so great!
Incredible! We got a few pastries (croissant, pain au chocolate, raspberry tart) and brought them to the Eiffel Tower and they were perfect!
Très belle découverte, les produits sont excellents, ça se remarque dans la qualité d’un café ou d’un pain au chocolat. Le service est courtois et souriant, merci !

Excellente nouvelle boulangerie dans le quartier, ça fait du bien !
Le pain, les viennoiseries et les pâtisseries sont excellents, le tout à prix vraiment raisonnable !
Très bonne boulangerie, j’y ai pris du pain excellent, une galette de rois et un cookie exquis, les pains chocolat et les brioches garnies étaient aussi succulentes

Very good pain au chocolat con amandles. The cappucino (to go) was a bit expensive

Very good looking patisserie

Favourite bakery during our stay in Paris! My sister and I went here everyday for breakfast. Their millefeuille, chausson au pommes, and pain au chocolat were truly standouts. They also have some yummy sandwiches. Would highly recommend to all!
Je recommande à 100% cette boulangerie. Le pain au levain est excellent et se conserve super bien. Les viennoiseries et pâtisseries sont savoureuses. Service sympathique et efficace.
